description:
We are the founding fathers of mars, we want to create a map for the aliens of mars! So they could walk around and explore local coffee shops, bistros, and second-hand-vintage-consignment-boutiques!

We are also Engineers (in-training).
summary: ARES combines NASA's global Martian elevation data, an adjustable geographic map, official place names, and three-objective A* pathfinding. It enables users to explore any region of Mars, choose starting and destination points, and compare potential paths based on travel time, energy requirements, and terrain difficulty, while explicitly accounting for the limits of the available topographic data.
